description: Source code for the STMicroelectronics LIS2DU12 3-axis accelerometer sensor driver, including initialization, configuration, data fetching, and device setup macros.

methods.name: lis2du12_freq_to_odr_val
methods.description: Converts a frequency value to an ODR register value based on a predefined map.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_range_to_fs_val
methods.description: Maps a full-scale range to a register value.

methods.name: lis2du12_reboot
methods.description: Performs a software reset and waits for the device to be ready.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_set_fs_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer full-scale raw value.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_set_odr_raw
methods.description: Sets the accelerometer output data rate raw value.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_config
methods.description: Configures accelerometer attributes like full scale and sampling frequency.

methods.name: lis2du12_attr_set
methods.description: Sets sensor attributes for specific channels.

methods.name: lis2du12_sample_fetch
methods.description: Fetches sensor data for specified channels.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_convert
methods.description: Converts raw accelerometer data to sensor values in m/s^2.

methods.name: lis2du12_accel_channel_get
methods.description: Gets accelerometer channel data with sensitivity adjustment.

methods.name: lis2du12_channel_get
methods.description: Gets sensor data for a channel.

methods.name: lis2du12_init_chip
methods.description: Initializes the device chip, verifies ID, resets, and configures default settings.

methods.name: lis2du12_init
methods.description: Initializes the device, including optional trigger setup.
